Compound Wahala › Level 1

💡 Level 1: NEPA Don Take Light!

“NEPA Don Take Light!” = The power is off! The light goes off. Get the generator running!

▶ Play Level 1 free

What happens

The light goes off in Unity Compound and everyone starts shouting. The generator needs fuel before it can run, so you have to work out the right order: find fuel at Iya Bisi's kiosk, then pull the starter rope until the generator roars back to life.

What players practise

  • Doing things in the right order
  • Trying again after a funny mistake

Pidgin lines from this level

Every Pidgin line in the game also shows plain English. A few from this level:

Oh no! The power company cut the electricity again!
Narrator
Wahala don start! Help the compound get light!
"Wahala" means trouble.
Narrator
Electrician: "Na NEPA cut am, no be wire! I no fit help." 😂
Electrician: "The power company cut it, not your wires! I can't help."

I have fuel! Take this, my dear.

Hooray! The light is back!

More words: Naija Pidgin words & meanings.

Did you know?

In Nigeria, "NEPA" is still what many people call the electricity company, even though the old National Electric Power Authority was renamed years ago. "NEPA don take light!" means "The power is out!"

When you win

“You brought the light back to the compound!”
